title: Fault Night
text: A shift in the maintenance control centre of the district around Bf Neustadt, alone: faults come in by their report paths, and what is behind each is known only when a team has looked. Two emergency teams are on shift, one for signalling and one for the track, and a technician of each trade is on call. Rank the faults, send the teams, ask the signaller for a closure before anybody works in the track, and decide what a team does with what it finds: a repair for good, a quick one that may not hold, or guarding a danger until the right team comes.
debrief: Which fault did you send a team to first, and why? What did the faults that waited cost?
A team stood at the signal and the work was in track G2. Who may close a track, and what could have happened without the closure?
Where did you send a team before you knew the cause? What did you go by, and was it the right trade?
A provisional repair or one for good: when was which the better choice, and what did it cost when it did not hold?
Was a technician on call worth the four hours of overtime?
